blk_part_01_part_1_what_does_best_mean.text: People may call LINE the best because it connects them with the people and services around them. To understand why many people call it the best app, first look at how network effects work. This is called a **network effect**: an app becomes more useful when more people in your community use it. If your family, friends, workplace, and local organizations are all on LINE, you may need only one main communication app.

blk_part_05_part_5_the_case_for_and_agai.text: There are also reasons to be careful. In 2023, LY Corporation reported unauthorized access and confirmed or possible leakage of user-related personal data. It said that bank details, credit-card numbers, and LINE chat conversations were not included. The company also says LINE uses several encryption technologies and publishes reports about them. These protections matter, but no large online service can remove every security or data risk. In addition, LINE’s regional concentration means it cannot be the most useful app for everyone. “Best” is therefore a personal and local judgment, not a universal fact.
